_comment: RepCall remote app config. The app reads this at launch. To FORCE everyone below a version to update, raise that platform's min_version and push — takes effect within minutes. min_version 0.0.0 = nothing enforced. latest_version drives an optional soft nudge. RAISE EACH PLATFORM ONLY ONCE ITS STORE ACTUALLY SERVES THAT BUILD: arming ahead of propagation tells people to fetch something that is not there yet.

music._comment: Set enabled to false to remove ALL Apple-supplied music content (cover art, 30-second previews, the Apple Music badge) from every installed app at its next launch, leaving an attached song as plain text. Contractual: Apple can require its Promo Content to come down and a store build cannot be recalled. Absent or true = music is on.
